# picohttpparser source snapshot

Source: `https://github.com/h2o/picohttpparser`

Commit: `f4d94b48b31e0abae029ebeafcfd9ca0680ede58`

The upstream `picohttpparser.c` and `picohttpparser.h` are retained unchanged.
`LICENSE` is the MIT notice from their headers. `protocols/http` uses them to
parse HTTP/1.x heads and chunked bodies.
